card.name: Rounding doses down in conversions
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "down" after "Round" in opioid dose-conversion steps. Also weaker on words like "dosage" or "that" in sentences about making sure the dose is appropriate.

modes.label: Round down
modes.description: The word "down" after "Round" when converting opioid doses to an available strength.
modes.example: Round<< down>>, if necessary, to the appropriate Meth

modes.label: Dose-check wording
modes.description: Words like "that", "one" or "dosage" in sentences about confirming or adjusting the dose.
modes.example: the<< dosage>> may need to be increased.
